dhp360:4:
saṃvaro → cakṣuṣā saṃvaro sādhu sādhu śrotreṇa saṃvaraඃ 
kāyena saṃvaro sādhu manasā sādhu saṃvaraඃ 
sarvatra saṃvṛto bhikṣuඃ sarvaduඃkhāt pramucyate. (mahāvastu 3. piṭa. 423)
dhp361:6:
pamuccati → kaena sañamu sadhu sadhu vayai sañamu. 
manena sañamu sadhu sadhu savatra sañamu. 
savatra sañato bhikhu sava dugatio jahi. (prā. dha. B . 9)
dhp362:4:
bhikkhuṃ → hatasañatu padasañatu vayasañatu savutidrīo 
ajhatmarato samahito eko satusito tamahu bhikhu (prā. dha. B. 10)
dhp363:4:
bhāsitaṃ → yo muhena sañato bhikhu matabhati anudhato 
arthadharmu ji deseti mayuru tasa hasita. (prā. dha B. 11)
dhp364:4:
parihāyati → dharmārāmo dharmarato dharmamanuvicittayan 
dharmaṃ samanusamaran bhikṣuඃ saddharmānna parihāyati. (mahāvastu. 3. pi. 421)
dhp365:4:
nādhigacchati → salabhu tatimañe a nañeṣa savihao sia. 
añeṣa saddhamiha bhikhu samadhi nādhikajatī. (prā. dha. B . 20)
dhp367:4:
vuccati → savasu namaruvasa yasa nathi mamaita
asata i na śoyati so hu hikhu tu vucati (prā. dha. B . 38)
dhp368:4:
sukhaṃ → maitrīvihāri yo bhikṣuඃ prasanno buddhaśāsane 
adhigacchati padaṃ śāntaṃ aśecanaṃ ca mocanam. (mahāvastu 3. 421) 
metra vihāra ye bhikkhu prasanu budha śasa......... 
paḍivindhu pada śata sagharavośamu subha. (prā. dha. B . 29)
dhp369:4:
nibbāṇamehisi → siṃca bhikṣo imāṃ nāvaṃ siktā te lahumeṣyati. 
jitvā rāgaṃ ca dveṣaṃ ca tato nirvāṇameṣyasi (mahāvastu 3. 421) 
sija bhikhu ima nama sita tī lahu mesitī 
chetva raka ji dośa tato nivana eśiti. (prā. dha. B . 35)
dhp370:4:
vuccati → paja jina paja jahi paja utvari bhavai 
paja sagadhio bhikhu ohatino’ti vacati. (prā. dha. B . 37)
dhp371:4:
ḍayhamāno → jai bhikhu ma yi pramadi ma te kamaguṇa bhameṃsu cittaṃ 
ma lohaguḍa gili pramata kana dukhamidati dajhamano (prā. dha. B . 34)
dhp372:4:
nibbāṇasantike → nathi jhana aprañasa praña nathi ajhayato 
yasa jhana ca praña ya so ho nirvanasa sati a. (prā. dha. B . 16)
dhp373:4:
vipassato → suñakare praviṭhasa śatavitasa bhikhuno 
amanuṣa rati hoti sajama dharma vivaśatu (prā. dha. B . 12)
dhp374:4:
vijānataṃ → yato yato samaṣati bandhana udayavaya. 
labhati priti pramoju amutū ta vijanatu (prā. dha. B . 17)
dhp375:4:
saṃvaro → tatrai adi bhavati tadha prañasa bhikhuno 
idriyagoti satuṭhi pratimukhei........ (prā. dha. B . 17)
dhp376:6:
karissasi → mitra bhayea paḍiruva sudhasīva a.... 
paḍisaravuti asa aprak...... 
datu ayarakuśalo suhu bhikhu vihaṣisi. (prā. dha. B . 18)
dhp381:4:
sukhaṃ → pramojabahulu yo bhikhu abhivuyu paripriya 
adhikachi pada śata aseyana moyaka. (prā. dha. B . 31) 
(aseyana = asecanakaṃ) 
(moyaka = mocakaṃ)
